Name: SWANS by DRIJUCE (BFAV)
Author: DRIJUCE
Description:
[b]Optional Version[/b]
SWANS by DIJUCE + SWAN SOUND
﻿Adds swan sound to the game. Needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10747]SAAT[/url] to function.
﻿﻿SAAT doesn't have Audio Signal Processing yet, a feature that allows audio to undergo low-pass, high-pass, and other effects.
﻿﻿So the swans always give the exact same "honk" which can be annoying and repetitive. That's why I made this optional.

[b]Swans[/b]
Buy the swans for 7000g at Marnie's Ranch. They go in a deluxe coop.
It takes 7 days for the baby cygnets to grow up into adult swans. 
Variants:
﻿-Mute Swan
﻿-Black Swan
﻿-Black-neck Swan
﻿-Whooper Swan

[b]Animal Products & Artisan Products[/b]
Swans drop products every 3 days. Down Feathers, and a decent chance for Swan Eggs, which you can turn into Swan Mayonnaise.
The products will be added to the player's Shipped Item Collection in the game.
Swan Products give the same villager reactions as duck products, with the exception of Gus who will love the fancy haute-cuisine Swan Mayonnaise.
Swan Mayonnaise takes a little longer to produce than regular mayonnaise, but the input quality of the egg doesn't factor into the quality of the final product, as per regular mayonnaise.
﻿-Down feathers: 300g
﻿-Swan Egg: 250g
﻿-Swan Mayonnaise: 700g

[b]BFAV
[/b]BFAV 3.0.0+ is needed to run this mod.
For the latest version of Paritee's Better Farm Animal Variety (BFAV) check:
[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Mod_compatibility]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Mod_compatibility[/url]
[url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-47#post-29740]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-47#post-29740[/url]
